projects.name: RL for LLM Secure Code Generation
highlights: Designed VRPO, a reinforcement learning framework to improve LLM capabilities on generating functionally correct and secure patches by 2x
Engineered multi-GPU and multi-node distributed GRPO training using verl and DeepSpeed on an HPC cluster, achieving 4x speedup
Curated a verifiable code dataset with security and functionality tests for training and evaluation using a code agent system

projects.name: NOIR: Privacy-Respecting LLM System
highlights: Co-developed NOIR, a distributed LLM system using differential privacy to prevent prompt and response reconstruction attacks
Reduced NOIR inference latency by 3x by creating distributed inference with Ray, modifying vLLM with CUDA, and high-throughput gRPC packet transfer

projects.name: SGCode: Secure Code Generation System
highlights: Developed SGCode, an LLM-based system for secure code generation with integrated static analysis
Conducted analysis showing up to 90% functionality deviation on vulnerability patches generated by LLMs

projects.name: Mobile Agentic Systems
highlights: Co-designed a mobile agentic system that leverages LLMs to predict user intentions
Developed an end-to-end mobile application to collect real-world usage data

projects.name: Cellular Network Maintenance Scheduling
highlights: Designed an offline temporal graph reinforcement learning scheduling system for cellular site maintenance, optimizing for both operational efficiency and user experience
Processed and analyzed large-scale historical LTE and 5G network data to train and evaluate scheduling systems
